admissionInfo.text: Baccalaureate degree in nursing from a program accredited by a recognized nursing accreditation agency. Current licensure as an RN in Utah or eligible for RN licensure in Utah. Completion of an undergraduate course in statistics to include descriptive and inferential statistics. Application for admission to MSN program. Overall undergraduate GPA of 3.2 or higher, or GPA of 3.2 or higher in last 60 semester hours of undergraduate coursework. Three professional letters of recommendation.
